description: This source file defines a widget provider for displaying calendar events on the Android home screen. It includes methods for updating the widget UI with the current date and today's events by querying an app database.

classes.name: CalendarWidgetProvider
classes.description: An AppWidgetProvider implementation that updates a calendar widget with the current date and events.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Called when the widget needs to be updated; iterates over widget instances and updates each.

methods.name: updateAppWidget
methods.description: Updates the widget's UI with the current date and the list of today's events by querying the database.
